_comment: #475. Both SoMa ground-floor openings are vehicle-sized - the roll-up is 4.60 m and the
loading door 3.44 m - so they need 4.02 m between centres and the width gate has to be set
much higher than in the residential templates. countMin 0 with spacingMeters 9.0 across a 0.76
span withholds the roll-up below 11.8 m of frontage, and avoidExact with minSpacingMeters 4.5
withholds it below 12.5 m; the pair would touch below 11.2 m, so they never overlap. Below
12.5 m a SoMa building gets the loading door alone, which is the honest answer for a narrow
infill - warehouse stock runs 15-30 m and gets both.
Same schema constraint as noe_valley_victorian (see the note there): exclusion is
exact -> procedural only, so floor 0 is one exact plus one rule, and windows start at floor 1.
window minSpacingMeters 2.7 -> 3.4 stays under repeat.spacingMeters 3.6, so the 6x4 steel-sash
rhythm is unchanged; 3.40 = 2.30 + 1.10 is exactly what clears the roll-up.
The storefront preset for this neighborhood lives in soma_loft_commercial, not here: a 9.6 m
shopfront cannot share floor 0 with a roll-up at any facade width.
